3. 这揭示了树级超引力下的共同几何结构，但该隐藏对称关系能否延伸至有限耦合及弦和量子修正仍待检验。

title: Boundary dualities of symplectic Chern-Simons theories and minimal models
abstract: We propose that a Neumann-type boundary condition of the 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ $USp(2n)$ Chern-Simons theory at the level $-(n+\frac32)$ with a fundamental chiral multiplet is dual to a Dirichlet-type boundary condition of an Abelian rank-$0$ theory. In a topological twist we propose that it supports the affine vertex operator algebra (VOA) $L_n(\mathfrak{osp}(1|2))$. With the corresponding specialization of the fugacities, the line defect half-indices of the antisymmetric Wilson lines give, up to monomials, the supercharacters of all its modules, which coincide up to signs with the characters of the Virasoro minimal model $M(2,2n+3)$. We extend the duality to the level $-(n+\ell+\frac12)$ and propose that the boundary VOA is $L_n(\mathfrak{osp}(1|2\ell))$. Together with the Giveon-Kutasov type duality and the mirror symmetry, the proposed dualities form a web of dualities of the boundary conditions and the line operators. For other gauge groups with real matter we propose that the boundary VOA in the holomorphic twist is the commutant of the gauge currents in free real fermions, which is the Ising model for $Spin(7)$ with the spinor and the $\mathcal N=1$ superconformal minimal model $SM(3,5)$ for $G_2$ with $\mathbf7$.
summary:
1. 作者借助半指标，提出含基本手征物质、能级为−(n+3/2)的三维𝒩=2 USp(2n)陈–西蒙斯理论的诺伊曼型边界与阿贝尔秩零理论的狄利克雷型边界对偶。
2. 拓扑扭曲下，特化后的反对称Wilson线半指标除单项式因子外给出猜想边界代数L_n(osp(1|2))的全部模超特征标，后者与极小模型M(2,2n+3)的特征标仅差符号。
3. 更高能级的推广可连接更广的边界条件与线算符对偶网络，但所提对偶及边界代数识别仍属猜想。

title: Bions and infrared renormalons in Kähler sigma models with $U(1)$ isotropy
abstract: We study semiclassical bion contributions to the vacuum energy of Kähler sigma models with two-dimensional target spaces on $\mathbb{R} \times S^1$ with twisted boundary conditions. This is first illustrated in the deformed $\mathbb{CP}^1$ model, where explicit real and complex bion solutions are constructed in a manner analogous to that used in its quantum-mechanical reduction [1]. Evaluating the bosonic and fermionic fluctuations at one loop, we obtain the effective action with both the coupling constant and the elongation parameter properly renormalized. Integration over the bion quasi-moduli space using Lefschetz thimbles then gives the leading nonperturbative contribution, which the real and complex bion contributions cancel at the supersymmetric point, while the first imaginary ambiguity appears when deviating from the supersymmetric point. Requiring its cancellation against the perturbative ambiguity allows us to infer the corresponding infrared-renormalon pole. This is an explicit example generalizing the resurgent structure of the $\mathbb{CP}^1$ model in [2] from one coupling to two renormalized parameters. The calculation further extends to Kähler targets of one complex dimension with a $U(1)$ symmetry. At leading dilute one-loop order, the target dependence enters through the moment-map difference and the metric normalizations at the two fixed points. The ambiguity structure and infrared scaling of the bion weight are common to these targets, while the inferred pole position depends on the target metric.
summary:
1. 为研究bion与红外重整子的联系，作者在扭曲圆柱上的变形CP¹模型中计算一圈涨落和Lefschetz准模积分，并推广至具U(1)等距的球面Kähler靶空间。
2. 计算再现耦合与伸长参数的联合重整化，实、复bion在超对称点相消，虚部歧义始于破缺源二阶，且各靶空间的bion权重共享红外标度$(\Lambda R)^{4mR}$。
3. 稀薄一圈近似下，由歧义抵消推得的正轴Borel极点依赖靶空间的矩映射差，其位置和留数尚待有限半径微扰计算验证。

title: Quantum Langlands correspondence for Painlevé II
abstract: We construct an irregular KZ-BPZ correspondence for quantum Painlevé II from a rank-three Wakimoto-Whittaker module. The irregular KZ equation and the quantum isomonodromy equation form a joint affine system whose Drinfeld-Sokolov reduction yields scalar BPZ equations. We obtain matrix-integral solutions of this system for one fundamental insertion. An exact quantum Langlands duality exchanges the fundamental insertion with the zero of the dual Whittaker differential and allows affine solutions to be reconstructed from the BPZ equations. This duality interchanges the classical and Nekrasov-Shatashvili limits, which yield the Painlevé II Lax connection and an irregular Gaudin oper, respectively.
summary:
1. 为统一量子Painlevé II的仿射与标量描述，作者基于秩三Wakimoto–Whittaker模，以扭曲DS约化将联合KZ–等单值系统映为双BPZ方程。
2. 级别反演κ↔κ⁻¹给出解空间的精确可逆对偶，交换基本插入与Whittaker零点，并互换经典Painlevé动力学与NS极限的Gaudin谱描述。
3. NS鞍点的双割形式大N极限恢复H₁理论的Seiberg–Witten曲线、微分与预势，连接规范理论几何与Bethe谱，但显式矩阵积分解限于整数屏蔽扇区。

title: Geometry of Gauge-invariant Quantum Fields
abstract: Gauge-invariant representatives of massless gauge fields generally involve inverse differential operators. We trace this non-locality to the homotopy contracting the free gauge complex and replace it, at field level, by a local map using an independent scalar and a differential constraint. We discuss the BRST completion needed to preserve the physical content and the relation to the Stückelberg theory. We finally comment on the extension of this approach to non-Abelian gauge groups via the extension to interactions through $L_\infty$ homotopy transfer.
summary:
1. 针对无质量规范场能否用局域不变变量描述的问题，作者在阿贝尔自由规范复形中引入独立补偿标量及微分约束。
2. 作者将非局域性定位于收缩同伦，在扩充场空间中构造局域投影与同伦并给出BRST约束扇区，但消去标量后仍恢复原非局域代表。
3. 该构造为借助同伦转移推广至非阿贝尔理论提供起点，但相互作用下的完整BRST构造、重整化及量子等价性仍待研究。

title: Gravitational Particle Production and Locality of the Wavefunction-Squared
abstract: We show that no particle production due to the background geometry implies the locality of the wavefunction-squared for free heavy masses on expanding cosmologies. On global de Sitter of odd dimensions these two stem from the same identity, whereas in the Poincare patch neither occur under any condition. These two phenomena both depend on the behaviour of the out modes at far future and we show that they almost always come together for systems with an out mode that has a phase with separated time and momentum dependency at far future. This will be true for most expanding cosmologies. We comment on how the discussion can be connected to Green's functions and on some previous results in the literature that are seemingly contrary to our conclusions.
summary:
1. 为厘清引力粒子产生与波泛函模方局域性的联系，作者用模展开、玻戈留波夫变换及正则对易关系分析德西特时空中的自由重标量场。
2. 从入态真空出发，奇数时空维全局德西特的零粒子产生与远未来局域核源于同一模恒等式，而庞加莱片在所有维度均有粒子产生及非局域核。
3. 当出态模远未来相位的时间与动量依赖可加分离时，无粒子产生足以保证局域性，涵盖幂律膨胀等背景，但逆命题尚无一般证明。

title: Tunneling from an oscillating state in quantum field theory
abstract: How does a scalar field oscillating about a metastable minimum decay? For a coherent state with $\langle q(t) \rangle = a \cos mt$ we find two results. When $mR \ll 1$, with $m$ the mass and $R$ the bubble radius, the decay at time $t$ is a Coleman bubble in the frozen potential $U_t(\eta) = U(\langle q \rangle +\eta)-U(\langle q \rangle)-U'(\langle q \rangle)\eta$, for any amplitude. At small amplitude but any $mR$, $B(t)=B_0 - a \mathcal{M} \cos mt+O(a^2)$, with $\mathcal{M}$ set by the tail of the vacuum bounce; for a thin wall $\mathcal{M} \propto e^{mR}$, so exponentially small oscillations change the rate significantly. Both results follow from a Euclidean source construction. The same method computes the tunneling rate of a field slowly rolling in one direction and metastable in another.
summary:
1. 针对亚稳标量场振荡态如何隧穿衰变，作者以欧氏源构造缓慢制备的相干态，计算成核指数，并以量子力学实时演化和四维鞍点检验。
2. 慢变极限归结为扣除线性项的冻结势中成核，小振幅下指数修正线性依赖振幅并随相位变号，薄壁响应系数随泡半径指数增长，使指数微小振荡也能显著改变衰变率。
3. 该框架可用于慢滚多场背景，但四维检验仅确认鞍点自洽性，场论实时验证、大振幅非绝热衰变及半经典前因子仍待研究。

title: Landau Theory of Black-Brane Phase Transitions from Kasner Singularities
abstract: We develop a Landau theory of a continuous black-brane phase transition using the geometry of the black-hole interior. The normal phase has a Reissner--Nordström Cauchy horizon, whereas the scalarized phase ends at a Kasner singularity. A conserved radial charge determines the grand potential from either endpoint and permits a direct phase comparison. At the critical point, we show analytically that the quadratic correction to the conserved radial charge vanishes. Using the inverse Kasner scalar velocity as an interior order parameter, we then construct a Landau potential whose coefficients are determined entirely from the terminal singularity. The Iyer--Wald first law relates this potential to the conventional boundary Landau theory and fixes its quartic coefficient. For two models with different scalar self-interactions, the resulting theory predicts the critical scaling of the Kasner order parameter and the grand-potential difference between the phases, in agreement with fully backreacted numerical solutions.
summary:
1. 为研究黑洞内部如何编码连续相变，作者在四维AdS标量化黑膜中结合径向守恒量与Iyer–Wald第一定律，以终态Kasner标量速度的倒数构建朗道势。
2. 临界点守恒量的二阶修正严格抵消，所得势预测序参量按温差平方根消失、巨势差正比于温差平方，均与两种不同自相互作用模型的全反作用数值解一致。
3. 结果表明终态奇点编码近临界热力学，但目前仅在均匀黑膜的连续相变附近验证，推广至非均匀体系尚需引入梯度项。

title: Generalizations of Courant brackets in the T-dual description of a weakly curved string background
abstract: When T-duality is realized as a canonical transformation, the standard Courant bracket is T-dual invariant, while the $B$- and $\theta$-twisted Courant brackets are exchanged. We determine how these relations are modified for a closed bosonic string moving in a weakly curved background with a constant metric and a Kalb-Ramond field with linear coordinate dependence. We work to first order in its constant field strength. The T-dual background fields depend on a line integral of auxiliary worldsheet gauge fields, making the dual description nonlocal. We construct generalized charges whose parameters depend on this line integral and calculate their Poisson bracket algebra using the T-duality transformation laws and the canonical brackets of the initial theory. The resulting algebra yields a weakly curved generalization of the Courant bracket and its associated Courant algebroid. We establish an explicit isomorphism with the standard Courant algebroid by transporting the bracket, pairing, and anchor. Applying $B$- and $\theta$-shifts to the dual currents, we obtain weakly curved generalizations of the respective twisted Courant brackets. We show that these brackets provide the T-dual realizations of the initial $\theta$- and $B$-twisted Courant brackets, respectively, and identify the corresponding Courant algebroid isomorphisms.
summary:
1. 为确定非局域T对偶如何改变Courant结构，作者在弱曲背景的闭合玻色弦中构造依赖线积分的广义荷，并利用原理论的泊松括号推导其代数。
2. 荷代数闭合于修正的Courant括号并实现B与θ扭曲的对偶对应，显式代数胚同构要求同步变换括号、锚映射及偏离标准O(D,D)形式的配对。
3. 结果表明非局域对偶可与Courant结构相容，但结论限于经典理论的场强一阶近似，推广至更一般背景或高阶修正仍待检验。

title: Yang-Lee edge singularity at $\mathcal{O}(\partial^4)$ from the functional renormalization group: revised analysis
abstract: We determine the critical exponents of the Yang-Lee edge singularity as continuous functions of dimension using the functional renormalization group, retaining all operators at second and fourth order in the derivative expansion. At fourth order, we obtain $\eta=-0.153(7)$, $-0.352(9)$ and $-0.575(9)$ in $d=5$, $4$ and $3$, respectively, in agreement with the six-loop $\epsilon$ expansion. In three dimensions, these results give $\sigma=0.076$ and $\nu_c=0.359$. We locate the zero of the edge exponent at $d_\sigma=2.65(1)$, also consistent with the six-loop estimate. Continuing the fixed point through $d_\sigma$, we obtain $\eta=-0.795(21)$ and $\omega=1.90(6)$ in $d=2$, compared with the exact values $-4/5$ and $2$. For the complex Yang-Lee fixed point, convergence of the field expansion depends crucially on its reference point. Expansions about $\phi=0$ fail to converge with the smooth regulator used here, whereas expansions about the running imaginary field value at which the mass vanishes converge down to $d=1.3$. This representation preserves the exact relation between the thermal eigenvalue and the field dimension, and hence the hyperscaling identity $\theta_h+\theta_t=d$, at every field-truncation order. We trace the large violations reported in earlier works to the omission of the expansion-point motion when linearizing the flow, rather than to the truncation itself.
summary:
1. 针对杨–李边缘奇点临界指数的维数依赖，作者采用完整四阶导数展开的泛函重整化群，在虚场处展开并连续追踪复固定点。
2. 计算得到三维η=−0.575(9)及边缘指数变号维数dσ=2.65(1)，并确认先前超标度违背源于线性化时遗漏展开点运动，而非截断本身。
3. 随动零质量点展开严格保持超标度关系，使η的场展开收敛范围延伸至d≈1.3，但更低维结果仍属定性，需提高导数阶数或改进场表示以控制误差。

title: Reducing Massive Scattering Amplitudes to Normal Form
abstract: Local amplitude reduction is a crucial tool in effective field theory (EFT) calculations. While polynomial normal forms reproduce the massless y-basis, massive amplitudes require reduction rules that preserve little-group tensor contractions. We generalize Gröbner-basis reduction to covariant tensor identities, determining leading monomials in their contraction contexts and generating the higher-degree rules induced by mass determinants. Using three-, four-, and five-point replacement catalogs, we demonstrate symbolic-mass amplitude reductions and reproduce the independent three- and four-vector operator bases, providing traceable normal-form reductions for local EFT matching and syzygy analysis.
summary:
1. 为消除有质量局域振幅的运动学冗余，作者在旋量螺旋度框架中推广格罗布纳基算法，依小群指标收缩语境确定首项并生成质量诱导的高阶规则。
2. 三至五点算例验证了符号约化，四个可区分矢量在零、二、四阶导数下的基分别含4、56、141个结构，独立性经有限域满秩检验确认。
3. 该方法可为有效场论匹配提供可追溯的符号化简，但五点规则尚未饱和，推广至混合有质量与无质量振幅仍待实现。

title: Multiloop Unitarity from Airy Zeros
abstract: Hidden zeros are non-trivial cancellations that make amplitudes or integrands vanish on specific kinematic loci away from propagator poles. They have been shown to uniquely determine tree amplitudes and one-loop surface integrands in $\Tr(\phi^3)$ theory, without assuming factorization. Here we extend both the zeros and the uniqueness results to two, three and four loops at arbitrary multiplicity. We show that two types of zeros naturally enter the all-loop problem. First, tree-level zeros extend to all loop orders and fix relative weights within families of subgraphs attached to vacuum ``loop cores.'' We then show that Kontsevich's matrix Airy function can be used to generate a rich structure of loop level zeros that fix the relative weights of the loop cores themselves. The relative factorization and cut data required by unitarity therefore follow from the combination of tree and Airy loop zeros. These results bring within reach the emergence of unitarity to all orders in perturbation theory.
summary:
1. 为检验多圈幺正性能否由隐藏零点导出，作者结合边界零点与矩阵Airy函数的变形零点，重构Tr(φ³)理论的平面曲面积分核。
2. 在局域性、三次幂次计数及反射对称假设下，零点唯一固定任意外腿数的二至四圈积分核，仅余整体归一化，从而无需预设便导出相对因子化与切割关系。
3. 边界零点与基本Airy零点已推广至任意圈阶，但全阶唯一性仍需足够的变形零点，尚不能据此宣称全阶幺正性已获证明。

title: Solving the SU(2) BFSS model
abstract: We numerically solve the ground state wavefunction of SU(2) BFSS matrix quantum mechanics. We compare ground correlators against islands obtained using the matrix bootstrap and find agreement up to five significant figures. The power law tail of this wavefunction determines the three-point amplitude, which agrees with the computation of Herderschee and Maldacena. Beyond the ground state, we extract the non-perturbative four-point scattering amplitude using Lüscher's method. In the appropriate regime, we find agreement with the Born-Oppenheimer approximation that yields the well-known $v^4/r^7$ interaction. We also find explicit bound states with positive energies in various SO(9) irreps. These are closely related to the bound states whose existence was recently discovered by OpenAI. Finally, we identify metastable resonances in the spectrum.
summary:
1. 针对SU(2) BFSS模型的强耦合束缚态与散射，作者以对称性约化和加权超荷变分法求解基态，并用Lüscher法从有限盒谱提取相移。
2. 基态关联函数落入自举界限，最紧比较达五位有效数字，幂律尾确定的三点耦合符合解析值，低能散射符合v⁴/r⁷有效相互作用，并辨认出九个正能SO(9)单态束缚能级及亚稳共振。
3. 这些波函数可为更大N的非微扰散射提供构件，但计算复杂度迅增，且SU(2)束缚态的对称性稳定机制不能直接推广。

title: The Supercritical Ten Martini Problem
abstract: We solve the ten martini problem for the positive-Lyapunov part of the spectrum of any nonconstant real analytic one-frequency Schrödinger operator. The proof uses the intrinsic symplectic structure of the dual center of Ge--Jitomirskaya [28] and extends the Kotani--almost-reducibility strategy of Ge--Jitomirskaya--You [30] from two-dimensional centers to arbitrary finite center dimension.
summary:
1. 针对一维准周期薛定谔能谱康托结构的普适性，作者结合对偶辛中心、Kotani理论、近可约化与朗斯基恒等式，排除了超临界谱中的能量区间。
2. 对任意非常数实解析单频势及任意无理频率，谱与正李雅普诺夫指数能区闭包的非空交集均为康托集，将原有二维中心方法推广至任意有限维。
3. 这保证了充分强耦合下的全谱康托性，但不保证所有允许能隙均开启，也不涵盖一般次临界区。

title: Microscopic derivation of the classical KMS condition for one-dimensional Bose gases
abstract: The Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) condition provides an intrinsic characterization of thermal equilibrium, both in quantum and classical statistical mechanics. In this work, we establish stability of the KMS condition through the quantum-to-classical limit for one-dimensional defocusing Bose gases. More precisely, we consider scaled quantum KMS states in the (mean-field) semiclassical regime and prove that every associated Wigner measure satisfies the classical KMS condition corresponding to the nonlinear Schrödinger Hamiltonian. This result extends to an infinite-dimensional setting an earlier derivation of the classical KMS condition for finite-dimensional Bose--Hubbard systems. It also provides a complementary perspective on the derivation of nonlinear Gibbs measures from many-body quantum statistical mechanics.
summary:
1. 为检验热平衡结构的量子—经典稳定性，作者对环上及受困的一维排斥玻色气体，结合Wigner测度、Wick演算与谱正则化分析平均场半经典极限。
2. 证明吉布斯态族的每个Wigner测度均满足非线性薛定谔哈密顿量的经典KMS条件，将有限维结论拓展至无限维，并将KMS恒等式一阶约化的余项控制为O(ε)。
3. 该定理尚不能将极限唯一确定为非线性吉布斯测度，推广至无吉布斯密度矩阵的KMS态及需重整化的高维模型仍待研究。

title: Elliptic hypergeometric sum/integrals for orthogonal groups and Seiberg duality on the lens space
abstract: We derive new transformation formulas for elliptic hypergeometric sum/integrals associated with the orthogonal groups $\mathrm{SO}(N)$. The sum/integrals are written in terms of the lens elliptic gamma function, which depends on an integer $r\geq 1$ in addition to the usual complex variables, and they reduce to the elliptic hypergeometric integrals of Spiridonov and Vartanov for $r=1$. The derivation uses the $BC_n\leftrightarrow BC_{\tilde n}$ transformation formula proven in our previous paper, together with a duplication formula for the lens elliptic gamma function proven here. The duplication formula takes a different form depending on whether $r$ is even or odd. Physically, the new transformations show that the supersymmetric lens indices on $S^1\times S^3/\mathbb{Z}_r$ of the 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ $\mathrm{SO}(N)$ and $\mathrm{SO}(N_f-N+4)$ gauge theories related by Seiberg duality are equal for odd $r$. For even $r$, where the lens index depends on the global form of the gauge group, they show the equality of the contributions from flat connections whose holonomies lie in a common maximal torus. The $BC_n$ formula itself gives the corresponding statement for the symplectic groups.
summary:
1. 为检验正交规范理论的Seiberg对偶，作者用新证的透镜椭圆伽马倍增公式约化BC_n变换，推导四维N=1超对称理论在S¹×S³/ℤ_r上的求和积分恒等式。
2. 结果对任意r成立：奇数r时SO(N)与SO(N_f−N+4)的完整透镜指标相等，偶数r时仅证明和乐共处最大环面的扇区等权和相等。
3. 偶数r的非环面扇区仍未处理，补齐其恒等式有望完成区分规范群整体形式与离散θ角的完整指标对偶检验。

title: Connectivity and the equilibration of Boltzmann-type equations on dense graphs
abstract: We investigate the equilibration of solutions to a homogeneous Boltzmann-type equation whose collision kernel is given by a graphon encoding the connectivity structure of interacting agents. For a broad class of Lipschitz-continuous binary interaction rules, we show that, under suitable conditions relating the interaction parameters to the connectivity properties of the graphon, solutions converge exponentially fast towards those of the classical homogeneous Boltzmann-type equation without preferential connections, and hence towards its equilibrium distributions. We then consider in detail compromise-diffusion interaction rules and establish a quasi-invariant limit leading to a Fokker-Planck-type equation parametrised by the graphon connectivity. This limiting equation allows us to characterise explicitly both connectivity-independent and connectivity-dependent equilibrium distributions.
summary:
1. 针对连接结构如何影响平衡化，作者以图极限核表示固定稠密网络，用瓦瑟斯坦距离分析非线性玻尔兹曼型方程及其准不变极限。
2. 证明平均利普希茨常数之和小于最小与最大度之比时，解指数趋于全连接模型的平衡，并为妥协—扩散规则建立涉及谱隙与噪声强度的判据。
3. 极限所得福克—普朗克方程显式给出网络无关平衡及断连群体保留不同均值的平衡，为忽略网络的长期统计描述提供依据，但收敛判据仅为充分条件。

title: Numerical investigation of a MST conjecture for random Haar matrices
abstract: The state-to-state control time of finite-dimensional conservative bilinear quantum systems is bounded by the weight of minimum spanning trees (MST) derived from the drift matrices. For a spectrum scaling as k^3/2 , determining whether the control time vanishes as the dimension d tends to infinity remains an open problem due to the global correlations imposed by the Haar measure. We formulate two conjectures regarding the asymptotic behavior of the MST weight\,: a general decay to zero, and a scaling in 1/sqrt(ln d) derived from an independent Gaussian surrogate model. Numerical investigations up to dimension d = 18101 validate the general decay, confirm that the exact Haar model and the independent surrogate are statistically indistinguishable in mean at all tested dimensions, and extract the thermodynamic limit $\alpha$ = 10/3, which both models approach from below once the scaling variable 1/ ln d is adopted.
summary:
1. 针对临界谱λₖ=k^(3/2)下量子态间控制时间能否趋零，作者结合渗流分析与蒙特卡洛，比较Haar共轭漂移矩阵及独立高斯替代模型的最小生成树权重M_d。
2. 在d≤18101的采样中，两模型均值在统计误差内吻合，支持M_d按1/√(ln d)衰减，且以1/ln d作有限尺寸外推得到的M_d√(ln d)极限与10/3相容。
3. 结果支持无界控制下控制时间上界趋零的猜想，但Haar模型的渐近律仍待证明，均值吻合也不意味着涨落等价。

title: The Isoperimetric Flow and Synthetic Scalar Curvature for Causal Variational Principles
abstract: An isoperimetric flow is introduced in the setting of causal variational principles. Describing the whole space by the support of a minimizing measure, we define an area functional on subsets by a surface layer integral. Mean curvature is defined via the first variation of this area functional. Using the method of minimizing movement, the isoperimetric flow is constructed as a Lipschitz curve of measures with prescribed volume change. As illustrating examples, we introduce and analyze ``smeared variants'' of the mean curvature flow in Euclidean space and on a Riemannian manifold. In these examples, it is shown that our area functional coincides with the usual area up to specified curvature corrections. As an application of our general results, by analyzing the volume and area of small isoperimetric balls, we introduce notions of local dimension and synthetic scalar curvature.
summary:
1. 为从测度与相互作用核提取无预设度量的空间几何，作者在因果变分原理中以表面层积分定义面积，并用极小化运动法构造等周流。
2. 所得流可预设体积增长且在紧集上满足全变差范数下的Lipschitz连续性，光滑流形中归一化面积的短程展开恢复经典面积，并给出相互作用范围平方阶的曲率修正。
3. 小等周球的面积—体积关系给出尺度依赖的局部维数与合成标量曲率定义，可用于非光滑空间，但绝热极限的存在尚未证明。

title: Excess charge in the Engel-Dreizler model of atoms and molecules
abstract: We prove an explicit excess-charge bound for the exchange-free Engel--Dreizler functional of atoms and molecules. If $\alpha\lambda\le1/1233$ and $\alpha^3Z_k^2\le1/137$ for each nucleus, every finite-mass electronic minimizer whose total energy, including nuclear repulsion, is nonpositive satisfies $N-\sum_kZ_k<(5913/1000)\lambda^{3/2}K$. For the gradient coefficient $\lambda=1/9$, this gives $N-\sum_kZ_k<0.219K$. The energy hypothesis holds automatically for atoms and for local minima of the Born--Oppenheimer energy at which the electronic infimum is attained. The proof uses no symmetry of the density, restriction on the total nuclear charge, or minimum nuclear separation. We combine molecular Sommerfeld estimates with a convex nonlinear comparison in the variable $F(p)$. The failure of the latter comparison at very high density is represented by a nonnegative Newton potential. A quartic coercivity estimate, obtained from nuclear repulsion and a signed localized Hardy inequality, controls the total mass of this source. The chemical potential is retained throughout. Exact covariance yields the invariant parameter domain, and all finite numerical inequalities are reduced to rational arithmetic.
summary:
1. 针对相对论原子分子可束缚多少额外电子，作者在无交换Engel–Dreizler泛函中结合分子Sommerfeld估计、非线性比较与核斥力估计证明电荷上界。
2. 当λ=1/9、α≤1/137、各核αZₖ≤1且含核斥力总能量非正时，有限粒子数电子极小化态满足N−ΣZₖ<0.219K，其中K为核数，上界与总核电荷及核间距无关。
3. 该结果将模型内的超额电荷限制为正比于核数，但交换项与域外强耦合仍待处理，分子平衡构型的存在性亦未证明。

title: Time Running Backwards, and Where It Stops: Superoscillations of Proper Time and the Memory of the Environment
abstract: A quantum system prepared in a superposition of proper times - a clock whose worldline is superposed, or a clock at rest in a superposed gravitational potential - evolves, in each branch, by the same dynamics for a different duration. Post-selecting the control that sets the proper time turns the superposition into a superoscillation of the time-dilation factor: the system is found to have evolved for a proper time $\alpha_w t$, where the weak value $\alpha_w$ may exceed unity, vanish, or be negative - the quantum time-translation machine of Aharonov, Anandan, Popescu and Vaidman. We ask how far back such a machine can run an irreversible process. The test system is a sealed cell - excited atoms, the radiation field they emit into, and the absorbing walls, carried as one quantum object - and the witness is projective: atoms that had begun to decay before the run are found, in the post-selected sub-ensemble, more excited than when inserted. The answer is exact and depends only on the atoms' survival amplitude. With two branches the witness holds only while the decay is younger than the memory time of the environment, after which the emission becomes Markovian. Beyond it, the post-selection amplifies the minute difference between the contents of the cell in the two branches, set by the full energy spread of the atoms and their field rather than by the linewidth, and the witness fails. Reversing a decay past the memory time requires many branches, an environment with a strictly bounded spectrum, and a post-selection probability that falls exponentially with the number of environmental oscillations to be undone. The obstacle to reversal is therefore not entropy but bandwidth - the same bandwidth that makes the emission irreversible in the first place. We give four ways to superpose a clock rate, from hollow massive shells to inertial velocities.
summary:
1. 为确定自发辐射可被条件性反演的范围，作者以原子、辐射场和吸收壁整体相干叠加的密封腔为模型，结合固有时叠加与后选择，用存活振幅精确计算激发概率。
2. 双分支计算显示，预衰变原子的激发比例仅在环境记忆时间内可高于输入值，构成反演见证，而失效源于后选择放大由完整能量展宽决定的分支信息。
3. 更深反演原则上需多分支及严格有界能谱，成功率随需回溯的环境振荡数指数降低，方案仍属远超现有相干控制能力的思想实验。

title: Second-level termination of the PPT entanglement-cost hierarchy for two qutrits
abstract: We prove that for arbitrary two-qutrit quantum states, the semidefinite programming lower-bound hierarchy for the PPT entanglement cost terminates at the second level. Therefore, under operations preserving positive partial transpose, its zero-error asymptotic entanglement cost can be obtained by a semidefinite program involving only three Hermitian matrix variables. The key to the proof is to shorten the feasible dual chain by one level; to this end, we combine finite certificates verified by exact rational arithmetic with analytic estimates near the boundary of the parameter domain. This result shows that a unified terminating level exists for two-qutrit systems, whereas no unified terminating level exists for all dimensions.
summary:
1. 为确定双三能级态在保持部分转置正性（PPT）的操作下的零误差渐近纠缠成本，作者结合126组精确有理数证书与边界解析估计缩短对偶链。
2. 研究证明任意双三能级态的下界层级均在第二层终止，其纠缠成本可由仅含三个9×9厄米矩阵变量的半定规划精确确定。
3. 这一结果消除了层级截断误差而非数值优化误差，但第一层是否足够及更高固定维数下能否统一终止仍未解决。

title: Quantum simulation of real-time bosonic dynamics with binary and unary position encodings on superconducting and trapped-ion processors
abstract: Simulating a bosonic degree of freedom on qubit hardware requires discretizing its position space, and the qubit encoding of the resulting lattice determines the circuits that realize its real-time dynamics. We compare binary and unary encodings of a position lattice on superconducting (IBM) and trapped-ion (IonQ) processors. Binary encoding applies the kinetic term through the quantum Fourier transform; unary encoding uses one qubit per site, single-qubit rotations for the potential and excitation-conserving exchange gates for the kinetic term. For a single degree of freedom the unary dynamics is a free-fermion problem, and its product formula compresses exactly into a nearest-neighbor circuit of fixed size. With about two hundred two-qubit gates, these circuits resolve tunneling in a symmetric double well on both processors, with the right-well probability falling from 0.97 to 0.06 on IBM and from 0.96 to 0.12 on IonQ, whereas binary product-formula circuits with several thousand two-qubit gates do not reproduce the transfer. Noiseless emulation indicates that this contrast reflects the compilation as well as the encoding: without the fixed-size optimization, a unary product formula that captures the transfer also requires several thousand two-qubit gates. Post-selection on the single-excitation subspace removes leakage, and because every energy eigenstate of the symmetric grid populates both wells equally, the measured population reversal bounds the coherence between energy eigenstates from below. Coupled-oscillator benchmarks, where inter-register interactions prevent this exact compression, show that the preferred encoding depends on the grid size and the evolution time.
summary:
1. 作者在超导与离子阱处理器上比较二进制和独热位置编码，以振子、双阱及耦合振子检验玻色子实时模拟的资源与精度。
2. 自由费米子结构使单自由度独热乘积公式精确压缩至步数无关的规模，约200个双比特门结合后选择解析双阱隧穿，两平台右阱概率分别由0.97、0.96降至0.06、0.12。
3. 耦合阻止整体固定规模压缩且小网格二进制电路更短，推广须统筹网格、时间与编译，不能将实测差异归因于编码本身。

title: Time Direction Entanglement Entropy of Free Fermion Ground States
abstract: While the entanglement entropy of a spatial subregion has been extensively studied, a properly defined entanglement entropy of quantum states in a time direction interval remains underexplored. We investigate the scaling behaviors of the recently defined time direction entanglement entropy (TDEE) for free fermion quantum states, which is computed from the reduced density matrix of a sub-Hilbert space that minimally supports all the time-evolved operators in the time direction interval. Based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices, we develop an analytical framework for understanding the TDEE in a time interval with discrete time step $\tau$. For disorderless one-dimensional (1D) systems (gapless fermions or band insulators), in different regimes of gap, bandwidth and $\tau$, we find the TDEE can exhibit area law (for nonzero gap), logarithmic law or volume law in the length of time. For 1D Anderson insulators, we numerically find the TDEE shows a Page-curve like behavior, growing at short time, and decaying in power-law at long time exceeding the crossover time determined by localization. In the continuum time limit $\tau\rightarrow 0$, the TDEE of disorderless gapless fermions, band insulators and Anderson insulators exhibit logarithmic law, area law and sub-area law, respectively. We also show that the sub-Hilbert space of a time-direction interval stabilizes in the $\tau\rightarrow 0$ limit, which is understandable as a subspace of the Hilbert space of the Lieb-Robinson causal diamond.
summary:
1. 针对时间区间纠缠的标度问题，作者在一维自由费米子基态中正交化时间演化模，结合Toeplitz矩阵半解析方法与数值计算研究单格点时间区间的熵。
2. 连续时间极限下，洁净无隙态满足S=(1/6)ln T+常数，能带绝缘体遵循面积律，而安德森绝缘体数值上呈先增后幂律衰减的类Page曲线。
3. 这些结果表明时间纠缠可借助动力学信息区分空间熵均遵循面积律的两类绝缘体，但相互作用体系中相应时间子希尔伯特空间的构造仍未解决。

title: Kinematic Quantum Geometry
abstract: Kinematic quantum geometry describes fast degrees of freedom (DOFs) that adiabatically follow states parametrized by both the coordinates and the velocities of slow DOFs. It extends Born-Oppenheimer geometry, which depends on coordinates alone, introduces mixed Berry curvatures, and modifies the effective theory governing the slow DOFs. We test its predictions in two setups: spinful particles moving in magnetic textures, and Dirac electrons in graphene coupled to an LC circuit. In the first, kinematic quantum geometry produces a velocity-dependent effective mass tensor and generates a Lorentz-like force nonlinear in velocity that can arise even in coplanar textures. In the second, it renormalizes the circuit capacitance and generates a Hall current nonlinear in the electric field. For small velocities, it reproduces recent results for electronic dynamics in external electromagnetic fields and in pseudospin textures. However, the framework can remain valid at large velocities beyond the perturbative regime, provided the kinematic states are sufficiently slowly varying.
summary:
1. 为描述超越玻恩–奥本海默近似的快慢耦合动力学，作者利用共动系本征态构建坐标—速度量子几何，并在磁纹理粒子与石墨烯—LC电路模型中作数值检验。
2. 混合贝里曲率重整化质量与电容，空间曲率则在共面磁纹理和石墨烯中分别产生非线性横向力与电场三阶霍尔响应。
3. 绝热规范势在空间缓变且加速度较小时，该框架可超越低速微扰，但当前忽略速度涨落与耗散。

title: Which data samples matter when training a quantum model?
abstract: The expressivity, loss landscapes, and generalization behavior of quantum machine learning models have been studied extensively, yet mainly from a model-centric point of view. Little is known about the compatibility of particular quantum models with specific datasets. In this work, we study quantum machine learning models with a data-dependent focus by establishing a quantum-compatible form of the V-usable information. This metric quantifies the information a model can extract from a dataset, enabling a direct, data-centric comparison of different models. We employ this metric to study which data points contribute most significantly to a model's learning process. This enables us to develop an informed preselection strategy for data subsets that can significantly improve the data efficiency of the training pipeline. This work establishes the V-usable information as a powerful diagnostic tool for learning dynamics and a practical route to data-efficient quantum machine learning.
summary:
1. 针对量子模型与数据的匹配问题，作者将V可用信息及逐点指标推广到参数化量子线路，在量子相分类等任务中诊断样本的学习价值。
2. 优先选取随机初始化时逐点信息低的样本，无需预训练即可筛选数据，在50量子比特张量网络模拟中用20%数据达到71.6%测试准确率，全数据为74.2%。
3. 结果支持依据模型与数据的匹配改善训练数据效率，但空输入基线并不唯一，硬件噪声下的稳健性仍待检验。

title: FusionQ: A Generic and Optimal Decoding Framework for Ultra-Low-Latency Quantum Error Correction
abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) decoding has traditionally been organized around fixed decoding instances: a monolithic space-time detector error model (DEM), or a predetermined temporal window, is handed to a backend decoder after enough syndrome data has arrived. This paper presents FusionQ, a fusion decoding framework that changes this paradigm by deriving local decoding tasks from the observed syndrome and then fusing their results into a single global correction. Instead of forcing every shot through the same global or windowed problem, FusionQ builds open-boundary local DEMs around fired detector clusters and expands the corresponding footprints only when a local optimum uses virtual boundary errors. FusionQ is generic in the decoder backend: the scheduler requires only a local solution and a boundary-use flag, so exact solvers, matching-style decoders on graphlike DEMs, and heuristic decoders can share the same runtime. We prove a compositional optimality theorem: with an exact minimum-weight local backend and boundary-free publication, fusing the published local decoding results yields a global most-likely error (MLE) solution of the original DEM. Our evaluation shows that, with an exact backend, FusionQ matches the monolithic MLE result on every shot. Across decoder backends, FusionQ substantially reduces decoding latency by overlapping local decoding with hardware syndrome acquisition.
summary:
1. 针对量子纠错的在线解码延迟，作者提出FusionQ，按综合征构建开放边界局部误差模型，依虚拟边界使用情况扩展、融合任务，使解码与采集重叠。
2. 精确且不使用虚拟边界的局部解在簇仅边界相交等条件下可融合为全局最小权重解；每轮采集5毫秒时，表面码算例的采集后p99延迟为0.54毫秒。
3. 该框架有望支持跨码族实时纠错，但延迟基于理想并行资源下的轨迹回放，真实硬件及微秒级端到端性能仍待验证。

title: How wide must an eavesdropper be? Leakage of a toric-code logical bit to a strip and the Nishimori point
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers hand pieces of each logical qubit to separate decoder modules and shared readout lines. How much does a piece reveal? We prove that for any region and any Pauli noise, including correlated noise, an observer's optimal advantage in learning a logical bit is exactly 1 - 2 P_fail, where P_fail is the failure probability of maximum-likelihood decoding confined to that region. Two lessons follow. Geometry, not noise, provides the protection: a region that misses a single column of the code learns exactly nothing at any noise level, while a region that spans the code is protected by noise only at impractical distances (d > 350 for one row at a 10^-3 flip rate). And width is a poor guide to risk: under i.i.d. noise a two-row strip learns exactly as little as one row, yet below threshold an eavesdropper needs a width growing only as ln d. Through the identity, the strip's operational threshold is the Nishimori point of the random-bond Ising model, and a Walsh-Hadamard transfer matrix up to width 16 locates it to within a few thousandths. On two IBM Heron processors (d = 3, 5), an emulated strip adversary shows the predicted jump at width three, and non-uniform qubit errors let a trained attacker profit from the second row that uniform noise makes useless. We turn these results into design rules for partitioned decoding and multiplexed readout. Code and data are included.
summary:
1. 作者以稳定子推导和转移矩阵研究噪声环面码的区域逻辑比特泄露，并用超导表面码读出数据离线模拟条带攻击。
2. 证明任意泡利噪声（含相关噪声）下，泄露优势等于一减两倍区域最大似然解码失败率；缺一列即零泄露，数值显示比特翻转阈值以下高泄露所需条带宽度仅随码距对数增长。
3. 结果为读出分区提供几何安全准则，但硬件检验仅限码距3、5的离线攻击，实际侧信道与相关多轮暴露的泄露仍待研究。

title: Exceptional points in non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion: From coefficient dynamics to state signatures
abstract: An exceptional point of a memory-coefficient equation need not have the same signature in every quantum-state observable. We examine this relation within exact non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion (NMQSD), following the same operator closure from its coefficient dynamics to the non-Markovian master equation obtained by noise averaging. A finite homogeneous lift identifies the Jordan chains reached by the causal initialization, while state reconstruction determines which contributions survive in a specified readout. Two models expose the distinction. For common-bath qubits restricted to zero and one excitation, a noise-independent lowering-form $O$ operator gives a closed master equation. Every defective decaying mode transfers its full pole order to a suitable unconditional excitation--reference coherence. A known third-order configuration illustrates both a quadratic--exponential coherence and cancellation of its highest-order term in another quadrature. For a position-coupled oscillator in a fixed-photon-number optomechanical sector, the exact closure contains a scalar noise-history term. On the regular normalizable branch studied for bath decay rates below the oscillator frequency, two second-order coefficient blocks lead to a double pole in the conditional displacement response to the NMQSD noise history, at long preparation age and fixed lag. The purely algebraic coefficient tail cancels from the conditional Gaussian width. Complete noise averaging changes the master-equation coefficients and combines conditional width with the weighted spread of state centers. Together, the models show how causal preparation, state reconstruction, and averaging give coefficient exceptional points a precise, readout-dependent meaning.
summary:
1. 为厘清记忆系数例外点如何进入量子态，作者以精确非马尔可夫量子态扩散和线性提升，在共浴比特与固定光子数光力振子中贯通系数演化、态重构及噪声平均。
2. 零、单激发比特的缺陷衰减模在适选无条件相干中保留完整极点阶数，而振子条件位移响应出现双极点、宽度代数尾抵消，条件动量变窄也不保证平均态变窄。
3. 这为按制备与读出识别例外点信号提供依据，但振子双极点限于正则可归一分支的长制备时间、固定时滞极限，无条件响应仍需另证。

title: A Compiler for Fault Tolerant Quantum Computing
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) needs compiler intermediate representations (IRs) that preserve error-correcting-code choices, syndrome information, and non-Clifford resource requirements through analysis, simulation, and hardware lowering. We report practical experience building FTQC, an open-source Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) dialect that makes logical qubits, syndromes, magic states, and Pauli frames typed static single assignment (SSA) values. Its error-correction-aware type system, two-level lowering design, and IR-resident resource analysis provide one inspectable pipeline to Open Quantum Assembly Language~3 (OpenQASM~3), the Quantum Intermediate Representation (QIR), Stim, and IQM hardware. Case studies across three code families show that typed metadata makes code-specific decisions verifiable and retargetable: on the 20-qubit Pathfinder at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, decoding reduced logical readout error by 3.3 times. They also expose hidden architectural costs: for a three-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT-3), a magic-state factory requires five times the peak qubits of the encoded circuit. These experiences demonstrate a practical foundation for developing and evaluating fault-tolerant compiler transformations across software and hardware targets.
summary:
1. 针对容错编译中纠错信息易丢失的问题，作者基于MLIR构建携带码族与码距的类型化中间表示，通过两级转换连接逻辑电路、物理后端及资源分析。
2. 在Pathfinder的单批512次采样中，解码使逻辑零态读出比例由79.3%升至93.8%；峰值估算显示QFT-3魔态工厂需195比特，为编码电路的五倍。
3. 该框架可支持纠错与编译协同优化，但读出改善尚不构成容错抑错证据，后续需开展码距标度检验并建立包含工厂调度的时空资源模型。

title: Early State Exclusion for $5\times5$ Jacobi Matrices
abstract: In this paper, we present a problem that arose from quantum computing, when the quantum state to be transferred completely vanishes before the first occurrence of the perfect state transfer. It was posed as an open problem for 1D quantum chains with $n$ of qubits, where $n>4$ is an odd number. We present the solution for $n=5$. The proofs are accessible to students who studied trigonometry and calculus. As for the set-up the knowledge of eigentheory and inner products from linear algebra is needed.
summary:
1. 作者以谱为{c−x,c−y,c,c+y,c+x}（x>y>0）的五比特近邻链为模型，通过谱重构与三角分析研究首次完美态传输前初态重叠能否归零。
2. 在支持完美态传输的条件下，作者证明提前归零当且仅当x/y非整数，并构造了传输前归零次数为任意给定偶数的链。
3. 这些解析结果为五比特链中初态正交化的谱设计提供依据，但七比特及更长奇数链的一般判据仍待建立。

title: The wave equation and two-electron atomic wavefunctions
abstract: Axisymmetric solutions of the classical wave equation in three spatial dimensions are shown to be in one-to-one correspondence to functions which annihilate the two-electron kinetic energy operator expressed in coordinates relative to a fixed nucleus.
summary:
1. 针对固定原子核下双电子动能算符零解的构造问题，作者借助超球坐标、福克变量及虚时间代换，将其映射到三维轴对称波动方程。
2. 研究证明两类解的一一对应，将巴特曼积分解及闭式波动解转写为动能零解族，并把已有对数解对应到静态波动解。
3. 这些解有望用于补充福克展开以满足边界条件，但尚非完整束缚态波函数，文中也未检验其对原子计算精度的改善。

title: PriorTilt: Decoding quantum LDPC codes with sparse perturbations of belief propagation priors
abstract: Although belief propagation (BP) is a widely adopted decoder for classical low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, its accuracy is limited in the quantum setting. We introduce \PriorTilt{}, a variant of BP obtained by selectively perturbing a small fraction of its prior log-likelihood ratios using offsets determined by recent posterior and outgoing-message statistics, while preserving the same message-passing rules. We compare \PriorTilt{} with Relay-BP and beam search decoders for circuit-level decoding of three benchmark codes. \PriorTilt{} achieves a lower logical error rate (LER) than both baselines at every tested data point. For the $[[144,12,12]]$ Gross code BB144 at noise rate $p=10^{-3}$, the LER reductions reach $4.3\times$ relative to Relay-BP and $3.1\times$ relative to the beam search decoder. At $p=10^{-3}$, \PriorTilt{} has lower mean decoding times than Relay-BP on all three codes and achieves mean decoding speedups of approximately $2.6\times$--$3.0\times$ over the beam search decoder. For BB144 at $p=10^{-3}$, \PriorTilt{} achieves an LER approximately $610\times$ lower than the standard min-sum BP decoder with the same iteration budget, while perturbing fewer than $0.5\%$ of its priors per round on average.
summary:
1. 针对量子LDPC码的信念传播失效，作者提出PriorTilt，依据近期后验及出边消息统计稀疏扰动先验，保留消息更新规则，并在三种码上进行电路级噪声模拟。
2. 在p=10⁻³时，BB144每轮平均扰动不足0.5%的先验，同最大迭代预算下逻辑错误率降至标准BP的约1/610，三种码的平均解码时间也均短于Relay-BP。
3. 保留BP结构有望便利硬件实现，但目前仅经模拟验证且依赖逐码、逐噪声率调参，BB144的99百分位延迟仍高于Relay-BP。

title: An Efficient Quantum Algorithm for Preparing Uniform Superpositions over Arbitrary Integer Intervals
abstract: We consider exact preparation of the uniform quantum state supported on an arbitrary nonempty interval of integer labels in an $n$-qubit register. For every $0\leq a<a+M\leq2^n$, we give an ancilla-free circuit using only one-qubit gates and singly controlled one-qubit gates. In the logical gate model specified in the paper, the direct construction has exact worst-case gate count $5n-9$ for $n\geq3$; its exact maxima for $n=1$ and $n=2$ are $1$ and $3$, respectively. A worst-case lower bound of $\Omega(n)$ establishes asymptotic optimality in the register width. In addition, the gate complexity admits an instance-dependent bound $O(\log_2 M+\epsilon)$, where $\epsilon$ is an offset-dependent parameter defined in terms of binary Hamming weights. We also derive a reflected construction and a classical procedure that selects the lower-count exact circuit. The direct construction admits an $O(n)$ logical-depth upper bound. We also treat bitwise-XOR images of intervals and arithmetic progressions with power-of-two spacing.
summary:
1. 针对n比特寄存器上任意整数区间均匀态的精确制备，作者通过共享二幂分块与成对旋转，构造仅用单比特及单控制门的无辅助比特电路。
2. 在允许任意旋转的逻辑门模型中，直接构造的精确最坏门数为5n−9（n≥3），结合Ω(n)下界确立门复杂度对寄存器宽度的渐近最优性。
3. 该方案已扩展至区间异或像、二幂间距数列及块加权态，可作为结构化输入制备模块，但离散门合成与硬件路由成本尚未计入。

title: Observation of strong electric dipole-dipole interactions between two atoms
abstract: We have prepared pairs of atoms at densities exceeding $ 10^{16}/\rm{cm}^3$ corresponding to $n\lambdabar^3>10$ and studied how they interact with light. In this regime, the coherent part of the electric dipole-dipole interaction is larger than the dissipative part, and a single photon emission can transfer large momenta (larger than ten times the single photon recoil) to the atoms. For off-resonant laser light, the atoms are dressed with an electric dipole moment of $\approx$ 1 Debye and interact coherently. This light-induced dipole-dipole interaction has been previously observed only in the far-field mean-field regime. For two atoms, the resonance is shifted by the two-body Lamb shift which is dominated by the near-field part of the dipolar interaction. Dipolar resonance shifts have been observed before only for many atoms interacting with the far-field part of the dipolar interaction. Our work sheds new light on photoassociation processes and paves the way for studying driven quantum systems with strong electric dipole-dipole interactions.
summary:
1. 作者将镝原子对限域于三维光晶格单格点内约20纳米的波包，结合动量成像、荧光谱及损失测量，研究近场电偶极耦合如何改变原子对的光学响应。
2. 实验在双原子层面观测到相干光诱导偶极力、单次发光伴随的约8ℏk原子中位动量，以及改变波包各向异性引起的8.6±2.5兆赫两体兰姆红移。
3. 该平台可进一步研究光缔合的量子动力学，但所测损失的红蓝失谐不对称仍缺乏解释。

title: Quantum-Assisted Generative Anomaly Detection: A Dimension-Controlled Study of Latent Refinement
abstract: Anomaly-based malware detectors learn what benign files look like and flag deviations. Generative approaches to this problem can make use of a "latent" or "prior" data representation, which is often chosen to be a Gaussian distribution. We ask whether the choice of prior distribution matters, and whether one produced by quantum hardware behaves differently from a classical one. Building on SAGEGAN, a style-based detector trained only on benign data, we compare three latent distributions: the original 512-dimensional Gaussian, a 48-dimensional Gaussian, and a 48-dimensional distribution sampled from an ORCA Computing PT-2 photonic quantum processor. We then refine each trained model's frozen representation using greedy and reinforcement-learning methods. Across ten random seeds, the quantum-derived model shows richer internal structure with better effective rank and latent similarity. It also benefits most from refinement. Though final detection accuracy is similar to that of the refined Gaussian latent, these findings show differences in latent geometry and refinement behavior between the trained configurations.
summary:
1. 为检验光子采样先验对恶意软件异常检测的影响，作者在SAGEGAN中比较48维PT-2先验与48、512维高斯先验，并对冻结模型实施贪心和强化学习细化。
2. 十个随机种子下，光子配置的归一化有效秩和矩匹配更优，强化学习细化联合校准使平均AUC提高0.0365，但最终性能与同维高斯无显著差异。
3. 结果支持进一步研究潜空间结构与细化收益的联系，但对齐策略不同且该规模采样可经典模拟，尚未证明量子优势，需引入更丰富的经典先验对照。

title: Polynomial Quantum Recurrent Channels for Matrix Inverse Actions: Deferred-Reset Dynamics and Chebyshev Filtering
abstract: We develop completely positive, trace-preserving polynomial recurrent channels for quantum solution-state preparation and derive fixed-point and time-varying tracking bounds. Across 2,880 synthetic configurations, resident Chebyshev recurrence improves accuracy-passing snapshot counts in 608 cases, ties in 2,271, and loses in one. A separate 360-scenario cost study shows that fresh recurrence is cheaper in all 184 jointly feasible scenarios (median resident-to-fresh cost ratio: 3.12), while resident recurrence uniquely satisfies accuracy requirements in 74 cases. At a logical noise rate of $10^-4$, neither recurrent method qualifies. Based on exact reduced-density simulations and assumed cost models, our results demonstrate conditional tracking advantages but no general end-to-end speedup or total-cost benefit.
summary:
1. 针对时变线性系统的解态制备，作者构造延迟复位幂多项式与有符号切比雪夫完全正保迹递归信道，推导收敛及跟踪界并用密度矩阵和小电路仿真检验。
2. 在精确实Julia扩张接口和已知谱隙下，切比雪夫信道相对指定未滤波递归，将理想增广态制备的查询复杂度对条件数的依赖由二次降为线性。
3. 驻留态显示条件性跟踪收益，但计入破坏性读出回放的假定成本模型中，184个共同达标场景均以重启更便宜，尚未证明端到端优势。

title: Analog quantum approximate optimization algorithm for solving the weighted MaxCut problem on three-dimensional single-atom Rydberg array
abstract: We theoretically investigate an analog implementation of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for the weighted maximum cut problem (MaxCut) problem. The protocol uses a three-dimensional array of individually trapped Rydberg atoms driven by globally addressed laser pulses, with site-dependent detunings applied near the Rydberg resonance. As benchmarks, we consider twenty randomly weighted 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices each. Problem weights are encoded directly in the interatomic interaction energies by choosing appropriate three-dimensional atom positions. We compare two parameter-optimization strategies: discretized quantum annealing and warm-start initialization using a graph neural network (GNN). The combined optimization strategy creates a portfolio that outperforms the Goemans-Williamson (GW) rounding almost in all instances in the noiseless case. We analyze the sampling statistics and the total pulse-time cost of both approaches. Finally, we emulate the performance of the optimized schedules on quantum trajectories using a realistic error model of the Aquila neutral-atom quantum processor.
summary:
1. 作者数值研究三维里德伯原子阵列求解加权最大割的模拟QAOA，以原子位置编码边权、保留全部原子间耦合，并比较退火与图神经网络热启动。
2. 限制代价脉冲时长可避开非绝热陷阱，两路线按期望割值择优后，20个12顶点图的无噪声平均近似比达0.966，19例超过GW单次舍入期望。
3. Aquila噪声模型下该优势消失，短热启动表现更好，后续可探索含噪优化与读出校正，但这些小规模结果尚不证明计算加速。

title: Reservoir-induced Quantum Phase Transitions in spin ensembles
abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of an open quantum system consisting of a collection of N two-level atoms in the thermodynamic limit coupled to bosonic reservoirs. Our results demonstrate that, when the system-bath interactions lacks a metastable minimum, as in the counterterm-free case, the system can undergo a quantum phase transition set by the reservoir structure rather than by coherent internal dynamics. Using exact quantum Langevin equations, valid even in the overdamped regime near criticality, where the loss rates can exceed the resonance frequency of the softening mode, we locate the critical point via the complex excitation spectrum and obtain closed-form reflection and transmission spectra that display the mode softening and an increasingly asymmetric lineshape near the transition.
summary:
1. 为检验环境能否独立驱动集体量子相变，作者结合总哈密顿量极小化与量子朗之万方程，研究热力学极限下耦合双玻色浴的自旋系综基态及响应。
2. 无反项浴的积分耦合越过χ_c=ω_a²后，系统与两浴同时出现基态凝聚，临界点不随耗散率改变，解析散射谱在过阻尼区仍显示软化及增强的不对称性。
3. 钇铁石榴石薄膜耦合开放超导波导是检验这些谱学预言的候选平台，但相变尚待实验验证，计算亦未纳入衰减核的虚部。

title: Maximal Violation of Mermin Inequality for Commuting von Neumann Algebras and Multipartite Vacuum Entanglement in QFT
abstract: Summers and Werner proved that Bell inequalities are violated maximally and generically in the vacuum of a relativistic quantum field theory in [S. J. Summers and R. Werner, Commun. Math. Phys. 110 (1987), 247-259]. Their criterion concerns two-party case, that is, there are two algebras of quantum observables: one algebra and its commutant. In this case, the maximal CHSH value is converged to in every normal state exactly when the algebra is strongly stable. In the paper, we study the corresponding question for three and more mutually commuting von Neumann algebras. We focus on the multipartite Mermin inequalities instead of CHSH ones. For the tripartite Mermin functional we show that maximal violation in every normal state is equivalent to the existence of a common sequence of asymptotic GHZ stabilizers. Strong stability of each local factor is an necessary condition for maximal violation, and a joint embedding of an infinite GHZ tensor product is sufficient. Counterexamples show that strong stability and type III_1 of the individual algebras, even together with tripartite duality, do not suffice to arrive at the maximal violation. The results are also extended to n>=3 parties.
summary:
1. 作者在相互对易的冯诺依曼代数框架中，通过强收敛分析和反例构造，研究三方及更多方Mermin不等式在所有正规态中最大违背的条件。
2. 三方所有正规态的违背上确界均为2等价于存在共同渐近GHZ稳定子序列，局域因子强稳定性必要但即使结合III₁型及三方对偶性仍不充分，而联合GHZ尾嵌入充分。
3. 这为多方真空关联提供了联合代数判据，但具体场论区域仍须验证渐近GHZ条件，适当分裂性质所允许的正规乘积态反而阻碍态无关最大违背。

title: Pool-free, residual-triggered ansatz growth for variational imaginary-time evolution: when a fixed operator order beats adaptive screening
abstract: Adaptive variational algorithms such as ADAPT-VQE and AVQITE screen an operator pool at every growth step, and ADAPT-VQE also re-optimizes all parameters. We study a pool-free alternative for variational imaginary-time evolution (VITE). The layers are fixed in advance by nested commutators of the Hamiltonian, grouped by symmetry and particle number, and the next layer is appended when the relative McLachlan residual exceeds a threshold. On five non-integrable systems (the mixed-field Ising chain and tori, and stretched H$_4$), this dynamic VITE reaches a relative error of $10^{-4}$ with 1.6-5.4 times fewer circuits than the cheapest of six to eight adaptive variants, including single-Pauli-string and qubit-excitation pools and batched ADAPT-VQE. On the chain the advantage persists from 8 to 16 sites. Screening and re-optimization account for most of the adaptive methods' cost. On the spin models, a longitudinal-field scan shows that the advantage requires broken integrability, which makes adaptive screening expensive. The advantage is lost on transverse-field Ising models, at tight targets (relative error $10^{-6}$) and where the schedule front-loads weak layers.
summary:
1. 为确定固定层序何时比自适应筛选更省资源，作者按对称性分组嵌套对易子，并以相对McLachlan残差触发变分虚时演化扩层。
2. 五组混合场伊辛及拉伸H₄无噪声算例达到10⁻⁴相对能量误差时，最省自适应基线仍需该法1.6—5.4倍电路，主要差异来自筛选与重优化开销。
3. 优势在横场模型、高精度或弱层前置时可失，按需筛选的混合策略尚待验证，且现有计数未涵盖电路深度和采样精度需求。

title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
abstract: We present a novel framework to learn a representation of quantum circuits based on the phase space formulation of many-body systems. Given that $N$-qubit states can be represented as probability distributions on a smooth $2N$-dimensional manifold, we show how unitary gates can be parameterized as normalizing flows between these distributions, opening a new avenue for quantum circuit simulation using generative models. We evaluate our method on three common families of quantum circuits, and show that its accuracy exceeds that of current state-of-the-art neural network methods for large system sizes.
summary:
1. 为研究量子线路的经典模拟，作者在2N维自旋相空间以Q分布表示N比特态，用逐门组合的归一化流近似其演化。
2. 三类态制备基准中，64比特簇态的Q分布经典保真度约0.96，10比特伊辛变分线路达0.985，高于变换器基线的0.965。
3. 未来可测试局域动力学，但纠缠门映射依赖输入态，训练成本随门数平方增长，且上述精度比较未匹配算力。

title: PINNverse meets Jordan--Wigner: learning the Hamiltonian of long spin chains
abstract: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNverse) learn the parameters of a quantum Hamiltonian from measured expectation values, but the network output grows as $4^N$ with the number of qubits $N$. We show that, for spin chains with nearest-neighbor exchange interactions, the Jordan-Wigner transformation removes this exponential cost: the dynamics closes on an $N\times N$ one-body density matrix, so the network needs only $N^2$ outputs and the data are local observables measured in five global settings. Parasitic $ZZ$ couplings (crosstalk) are included through a time-dependent Hartree--Fock closure. With synthetic data, the same network first solves the equation of motion and then recovers the Hamiltonian parameters of chains of up to $50$ qubits, with couplings learned to better than $0.1\%$. Errors in the local frequencies of long chains are removed by a direct least-squares fit started from the network estimate.
summary:
1. 针对长链哈密顿量反演，作者结合Jordan–Wigner映射与逆物理信息神经网络，以单体密度矩阵及五种全局测量设置对应的局域观测学习近邻XX链的耦合与频差。
2. 网络输出由指数规模降至N²，50比特链无噪合成数据的交换耦合平均绝对百分误差为0.034%，长链频差偏差可经网络初始化的最小二乘拟合修正。
3. 该框架有望辅助超导链校准，但尚待实验检验，已演示的ZZ串扰识别依赖含时哈特里–福克近似，仅适用于弱串扰和适中演化时间。

title: CV-TF-QKD
abstract: We introduce a continuous-variable version of twin-field quantum key distribution, using independent Gaussian-modulated coherent states and an untrusted single-photon relay. Full-record reconciliation and a binary phase-disclosure protocol achieve nearly equal asymptotic key rates against collective attacks. At fixed weak input-referred excess noise per arm, both rates per relay use scale as $\sqrt{\eta}$, where $\eta$ is the end-to-end transmissivity. For phase disclosure, we establish composable security against general coherent attacks using a bounded test of preparation intensities and sign-parity complementarity. For specified apparatus parameters, finite-key calculations incorporating detector inefficiency, dark counts, phase fluctuations, and reference overhead predict rates exceeding the pure-loss and matched thermal-loss repeaterless bounds. These results extend the twin-field advantage to Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum cryptography.
summary:
1. 为检验高斯调制能否获得双场优势，作者以独立相干态和非可信单光子干涉中继设计两种协议，并证明相位公开方案抵抗一般相干攻击的可组合安全。
2. 理想探测及固定弱输入等效过量噪声下，渐近密钥率呈透射率平方根标度；指定器件模型预测85分贝损耗、两天采集的有限密钥率下界为纯损耗无中继界的2.31倍。
3. 该方案为长距连续变量密钥分发提供实验目标，尚需校准源与探测器响应并验证译码性能，且采集时长不含译码。

title: Multiparticle entanglement in a time-dependent electron--ion--photon system
abstract: Photoionization provides a natural setting for entanglement transfer in the time domain: an outgoing electron can become entangled with the residual ion, while subsequent spontaneous emission may transfer these correlations to an emitted photon. We quantify the entanglement dynamics of the composite electron--ion--photon system using the von Neumann entropy of the one-versus-rest bipartitions, showing that the initially entangled electron--ion system evolves through a genuinely multiparticle-entangled state before approaching an entangled electron--photon state. Logarithmic negativity further resolves the pairwise entanglement, revealing in particular transient ion--photon entanglement. Further, its enhanced sensitivity to weakly populated Schmidt modes additionally exposes high-dimensional entanglement associated with the photon-energy continuum.
summary:
1. 为厘清荧光介导的纠缠转移，作者在仅以电离为条件的电子—离子—光子模型中，用冯诺依曼熵和对数负性追踪三方及两两纠缠。
2. 计算确认电子—离子纠缠经真正三方纠缠转为约一比特的电子—光子纠缠，并揭示瞬态离子—光子纠缠及光子能量连续谱中的弱高维纠缠。
3. 结果表明转移过程不能简化为双体资源交换，但定量分析限于真空与单光子扇区，多光子发射的影响仍待评估。

title: Quantum-Informed Graph Decomposition
abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a near-term quantum algorithm for solving combinatorial optimization problems, but its accuracy and resource requirements may scale poorly with problem size or structure, reducing its utility in practice. Approaches such as the Graph Decomposition for Optimization Algorithm (GDOA) seek to address this by iteratively reducing an input problem until it reaches a size where it can be solved using QAOA while maintaining the same optimal solution. This algorithm, however, requires solving integer programs that have exponentially many variables, and can result in suboptimal solutions, as the integer programs may contain slack terms. In this work, we propose a heuristic called the Quantum Enhanced Graph Decomposition (QEGD) algorithm. Its novelty lies in its use of QAOA as a subroutine for sparsifying a graph through local vertex-merging. The algorithm, when used to sparsify MaxCut problems that are then solved using QAOA, achieves higher approximation ratios across all tested graphs than GDOA for random 5-regular and 6-regular graphs. We then compare the time-to-solution and approximation ratio of QEGD to other QAOA variants a collection of Erdös-Rényi graphs. QEGD has higher approximation ratios on average than QAOA$^2$ and ParaQAOA on all tested graphs. It also results in higher average approximation ratios than DC-QAOA on sparse Erdös-Rényi graphs and comparable average approximation ratio on denser Erdös-Rényi graphs. However, its average wall-clock time is between 0.4\% and 5\% of the average DC-QAOA wall-clock time.
summary:
1. 为降低最大割求解的量子资源需求与分解误差，作者提出QEGD，利用单层QAOA局域关联引导顶点合并，并结合GDOA重加权分解开展数值检验。
2. 在100节点六正则图上，平均近似比由GDOA的0.8009升至0.9502，表明关联引导的局域合并可改善图压缩后的解质量。
3. 解析关联使该预处理无需量子硬件，但100节点测试中约8%—11%的合并仍产生次优赋值，未来可探索自适应阈值与合并纠错以控制局域误差。

title: Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization for Bounded-Payoff Imperfect-Information Games
abstract: Imperfect-information games with a graded-reward structure present significant computational challenges for equilibrium computation, since the payoff expectations must be estimated across exponentially large strategy spaces. Counterfactual Regret Minimization over the years has proven effective for approximating Nash equilibria, but Monte Carlo variants create a large overhead of sampling costs when the counterfactual values are estimated from sampled game-tree trajectories. We propose a novel Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization, a framework that uses Quantum Amplitude Estimation to reduce the computational complexity of the regret updates in bounded-payoff imperfect-information games, while preserving the convergence of its classical counterpart. We give a theoretical analysis of the resulting exploitability bound, discuss NISQ-compatible amplitude-estimation variants, the structure of their resource requirements, and outline what is needed to validate the potential advantage empirically.
summary:
1. 针对有界收益不完美信息博弈的均衡计算，作者将量子振幅估计嵌入反事实遗憾最小化，推导估值误差传播与电路资源界。
2. 对具有完美回忆的双人零和博弈，适当控制失败率可得可利用度界O(T^{-1/2}+ε)，理想条件下单次估值查询量由O(ε^{-2})降至O(ε^{-1})。
3. 该理论优势仅限查询复杂度，端到端加速仍受态制备、收益预言机成本及噪声下限约束，尚待含噪模拟与硬件验证。

title: Low-energy spectral-window truncation for compact U(1) lattice gauge theory
abstract: We prove a nonasymptotic electric-flux truncation bound for the entire vacuum-relative low-energy window of the original pure compact $U(1)$ lattice Hamiltonian. On a three-dimensional periodic cubic lattice with $N\geq3$ sites per direction at $\theta=0$, in the gauge-invariant zero-global-flux sector, the factorial-squared tail-norm estimate holds for every normalized vector in the window, without physical eigenvalue-isolation, window-edge gap, or nondegeneracy assumptions and without a window-dimension factor. It controls finite-time hard-wall evolution from the normalized projection of the same initial state. An analytic finite-volume strong-coupling example in this model certifies a nonvacuum band and an order-one plaquette signal change preserved by a specified finite cutoff. The same estimate yields precision-dependent sufficient cutoffs, an alternative linear isometric encoding by polar decomposition for reference-entangled inputs, and local electric-square readout bounds. At fixed positive bare coupling, physical volume, window width, and duration, cutoffs scaling as $\beta\log N/\log\log N$ with $\beta>2$ make state and bounded-readout truncation errors vanish under lattice refinement.
summary:
1. 为量化电通量截断对低能动力学的影响，作者在θ=0、零全局通量物理扇区的三维周期紧致U(1)纯规范理论中，以环境能量比较和Sylvester估计建立硬墙截断误差界。
2. 阶乘平方倒数型尾范数界覆盖整个低能谱窗，无窗边谱隙假设或维数因子，并控制有限时演化；有限体积强耦合例在Λ=3时仍保留超过1.29的方环信号变化。
3. 固定正裸耦合、体积、能窗与时长时，Λ∼β log N/log log N（β>2）足以使态与有界读出误差随格点加密消失，但这并不证明连续极限存在。

title: Classical phase unwrapping enables large-time-step unitary quantum Krylov subspace diagonalization
abstract: For computing molecular energies on early fault-tolerant hardware, unitary quantum Krylov subspace diagonalization (UQKSD) avoids both the deep circuits of quantum phase estimation and the Pauli-term sampling of variational methods by extracting the energies from a projected real-time propagator. At a small time step $\tau$, nearly linearly dependent Krylov vectors make the overlap matrix ill-conditioned. Our tests at fixed total evolution time show that additional Krylov vectors then add no accuracy, while the thresholded energy becomes increasingly sensitive to the choice of cutoff. A larger time step improves the conditioning and reduces the Krylov dimension $M$ needed for a target accuracy, but the energies are then known only modulo $2\pi/\tau$. We present Classical Unwrapping for Resolving Eigenvalues (CURE-QKSD), a classical post-processing method that leaves the UQKSD circuits and generalized eigenvalue problem unchanged and recovers the missing multiples of $2\pi/\tau$ from phase-consistency landscapes of one or, when needed, two UQKSD runs. In noiseless tests on six molecules with 12--20 qubits, all 28 targeted energies are recovered in their aliased regimes with final errors of at most $1.1\times10^{-7}$~Ha. Under Gaussian noise with $\sigma=10^{-4}$, the median error of the ground or first excited state reaches chemical accuracy at large aliased time steps with $M=20$--$65$, whereas uncorrected principal-branch energies are off by $0.7$--$115$~Ha. CURE-QKSD therefore makes aliased time steps usable for UQKSD calculations with smaller, better-conditioned Krylov bases.
summary:
1. 针对幺正量子Krylov对角化中小步长病态与大步长能量混叠的矛盾，作者提出CURE-QKSD，利用经典能窗及一至两次运行的相位一致性恢复能量分支。
2. 六分子态矢模拟在σ=10⁻⁴高斯采样噪声下，以20—65维子空间将目标能量误差中位数降至化学精度内，同时保持原有量子线路结构。
3. 该方法使更小、条件更好的子空间可用，但依赖能窗覆盖目标，不能修复基组相位简并，门噪声与演化近似误差的影响仍待检验。

title: Dynamical Casimir emission from Floquet-driven Landau polaritons: Gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition
abstract: Ultrastrong light--matter coupling of linear systems, such as Landau polaritons formed by a two-dimensional electron gas in a terahertz cavity, is described by the bosonic Hopfield model, and gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition (SRPT). Modulating the magnetic field alone has been predicted to enhance the cycle-averaged coupling and induce a Floquet SRPT. We develop an exact theory of periodically driven Landau polaritons. Including the electric field induced by the modulated flux (Faraday's law), the problem reduces exactly, by Kohn's theorem, to the electronic center-of-mass mode coupled to the cavity, whose Hamiltonian is a sum of squares at every instant. A theorem of Krein then guarantees stability to all orders above a computable drive frequency, the Krein frequency, for which we give a self-contained proof. Below it, the system is stable except within resonance tongues where the drive creates pairs from the vacuum, the dynamical Casimir effect. At high drive frequency the electrons experience the mean field plus a ponderomotive trap (the Fock--Darwin problem), not an enhanced coupling. A gauge theorem excludes a Floquet photon condensate for any band structure, including Kane nonparabolicity, for which we derive a generalized Thomas--Reiche--Kuhn (TRK) sum rule. The predicted transition arises from averaging the coupling in a fixed Landau-level basis, which yields an effective model that violates the TRK sum rule; under driving, gauge invariance also requires the induced Faraday field. The rule to modulate and average the minimal-coupling Hamiltonian, not the parameters of its projection, applies to any linear, minimally coupled system. Instead of an SRPT, magnetic modulation produces dynamical Casimir emission: Faraday-driven polariton--magnetoplasmon pairs at low threshold, and two-color photon pairs with up to 5--10~dB of two-mode squeezing.
summary:
1. 为检验磁调制能否诱发超辐射相变，作者计入法拉第感应场，借助科恩定理将太赫兹腔中抛物线能带二维电子气精确约化为质心—腔耦合模型。
2. 规范定理排除均匀腔场的Floquet光子凝聚，线性模型在可计算的克林频率以上全阶稳定，以下的失稳则对应动力学卡西米尔成对激发。
3. 理想模型预测近阈值5—10 dB双色双模压缩，提示太赫兹关联光源的可能，但电子加热和竞争性磁等离激元失稳仍限制实验可达性。

title: High-Speed Control of a Fluxonium Qubit via Picosecond Pulses from Josephson Digital Circuits
abstract: We develop a control strategy for fluxonium qubits based on picosecond single-flux-quantum (SFQ) pulses generated by Josephson digital circuits. A major challenge is that SFQ protocols originally designed for transmon control become inefficient for low-frequency fluxonium. In this regime, the asymmetry of flux and charge couplings leads either to excessive leakage or excessively long gate times. We show that this limitation can be overcome by two complementary protocols. The first protocol employs high-frequency SFQ pulse packets applied through the flux channel, offering a simple, analytically transparent, and robust approach for high-fidelity single-qubit control. The second protocol combines phase-shifted flux and charge pulse sequences to enhance the resonant drive and reduce the gate duration. Multilevel simulations demonstrate single-qubit gate fidelities above $99.99\%$; the simpler protocol remains robust under moderate variations of qubit parameters and flux bias, while the combined protocol preserves high fidelity while substantially accelerating the gate. These results establish SFQ-based cryogenic control as a realistic route to fast, accurate, and scalable manipulation of fluxonium qubits.
summary:
1. 针对低频fluxonium的慢门与泄漏难题，作者结合两能级分析和多能级模拟，设计约瑟夫森单磁通量子脉冲的高频磁通包及正交磁通—电荷控制方案。
2. 磁通包通过谱干涉抑制泄漏，实现68纳秒、保真度99.995%的π门，双通道方案进一步减小反旋转误差，在三组参数下实现17—27纳秒的π门，保真度均超过99.99%。
3. 这些模拟支持低温数字控制的可行性，但保真度经过虚拟Z校正，且尚未计入时序抖动、脉冲畸变与耗散，仍需实验检验。

title: Invariance can prevent overfitting and shortcut learning in Quantum Neural Networks
abstract: Many image classification tasks have labels that are unchanged by rotations and reflections. Equivariant quantum neural networks incorporate such symmetries by design, but the specific benefit of symmetry is difficult to isolate. Equivariant quantum circuits are usually compared with architectures that also differ in gates, structure or size. Here, we investigate the role of invariance in a controlled setting, classifying images whose labels are invariant under the dihedral group $D_4$. We compare four eight-qubit models with identical encoding, circuit structure and number of trainable parameters, and equivalent dynamical Lie algebras, and benchmark invariant implementations against non-invariant ones in terms of generalization error, robustness to shortcut learning and resilience to a realistic noise model. On four binary tasks, including MNIST and two scientific data sets of galaxies and red blood cells, the invariant models trained on a few tens of images show better generalization than non-invariant ones. Invariance also makes the models immune to orientation shortcuts: when trained with a class-dependent corner watermark, the non-invariant models learn the watermark and often drop to chance level when it is moved. We show that the gain in accuracy of invariant models persists also under a realistic noise model.
summary:
1. 为隔离不变性对量子学习泛化的作用，作者模拟四种振幅编码的八量子比特分类器，匹配线路结构与参数数目并保持动力学李代数共轭。
2. 四项小样本任务中，整体输出不变而非仅线路等变使平均测试准确率提高6—11个百分点，并阻断取向水印捷径。
3. 优势在超导器件噪声模拟中仍保留，支持利用已知对称性设计少样本模型，但仍无法防范群不变捷径，硬件表现尚待验证。

title: Operational limits of reference renewal for retained quantum-service results
abstract: We implement reference renewal to reconsider retained physical quantum-service results under a prespecified protocol. Twelve transitions retained six results each; ten completed renewal, eight met the prespecified endpoint, and five succeeded using retained results alone. The exact one-sided p=0.0546875 does not establish the recovery hypothesis. Incomplete references, binding failures and sequential waits expose operational limits. Offline reconstruction recovers decisions from preserved counts. Retrospective binding-plus-oracle checking accepts all 60 usable-transition results without renewal. With the exact oracle also supplying calibration scores, the study does not demonstrate incremental numerical-correctness utility of renewal.
summary:
1. 作者在IBM双量子比特核矩阵任务上，结合执行情境绑定与校准参考更新，检验保留测量能否无需重跑而按期恢复服务。
2. 十二次转换中十次完成更新、八次达标，但单侧p=0.0546875未支持预设恢复假设，且每次完整更新需39项校准作业。
3. 回溯绑定与绝对误差核查无需更新即可接受可用窗口内全部60个结果，而精确经典答案同时参与评分和检验，因此更新的额外正确性收益尚未证实，其必要性仍需独立论证。

title: Multidimensional Quantum Block Turbo Codes
abstract: The theory of turbo iterative decoding was brought into the quantum coding framework through the development of quantum serial turbo codes and quantum block turbo codes. In this paper, we present a theory for multidimensional quantum block turbo codes, a turbo decoding technique for multi layer product codes. We describe its algorithm and simulate the performance for the 3D case on a depolarizing channel.
summary:

title: The energetic cost of loading classical data in quantum computers
abstract: Quantum algorithms for machine learning, chemistry, and cryptanalysis often assume coherent access to classical data at negligible physical cost. We instead treat data loading as a hardware process and quantify the dynamic energetic cost of a quantum random access memory (QRAM) query on a superconducting processor. Using the metric-noise-resource framework, we relate query fidelity and power to gate duration, relative two-qubit drive strength, and the distribution of attenuation across a multi-stage refrigerator, while accounting for thermal photons and gate errors. We analyze the linear-depth multiplexer and the noise-resilient bucket-brigade architectures, adapting the latter to a native superconducting gate set and refining its fidelity analysis using the fully decomposed gate schedule. For a representative bucket-brigade QRAM query with a $12$-qubit address register we obtain a query fidelity of $0.969$. The query consumes $3.51\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{J}$ of dynamic energy, corresponding to an average dynamic power of $4.38\,\mathrm{W}$ and a peak of $64.4\,\mathrm{W}$. Our optimization shows that, at fixed target fidelity, the operating point and attenuation profile can change the average power by a factor of two or more.

title: Finite-Key Readiness and Authentication-Key Replenishment in QKD-Assisted UAV Edge Computing
abstract: A service that needs fresh quantum keys must wait for key release, and may be denied it, before protected computation starts. We quantify this cost for a trusted stationary UAV serving two ground gateways, each obtaining its keys from one finite-key decoy-state BB84 attempt with parameters fixed in advance. A count-level Monte Carlo model, reproduced by a semi-analytic model, links key acceptance to protected upload, computation, and download, including failed attempts and hover energy. At 26~dB effective optical loss, with authentication hashing at its proxy-benchmarked, near-zero cost, fresh keys raise the 95th-percentile completion time of both tasks from 10.37 to 28.65~s; hover energy grows in proportion. The scalar rate models evaluated here miss the deadline limit on the block size. The pulse budget lies in a window bounded below by authentication-key replenishment and above by the deadline; for a fixed source, channel, and acceptance model, the authentication debit shifts the floor, whereas hashing cost does not. At a 35-s deadline the largest tested loss with a non-empty window is 27~dB at 1\% misalignment and 22~dB at 2\%; at 3\% no tested setting has one. Conditional on the assumed acquisition probability, the selected configurations meet this deadline with simultaneous lower confidence bounds of 96.9--97.3\% on held-out trials, at 26~dB and at 18--20~dB with 2\% misalignment. A high-cost stress reference that charges hashing in full narrows the window and lowers these loss limits to 26 and 20~dB at the reference processing capacity. A small rise in error rate or loss pushes the deadline probability well below its target and drains authentication keys, while the protocol's security parameter is unchanged.
